review.why: Decides what belongs on a resume by country, industry and situation, with evidence tags and an audit report.
review.summary: Advises what to include, cut and order on a resume. Ground rules (never invent, employer instructions first), a four-test keep rule, tables for sections, length, countries and situations, myth corrections, and a report format with evidence tags. Optional Reactive Resume tool path to copy, patch and verify with consent.
strengths: Each recommendation carries an evidence tag: official, study, survey or convention
Country and situation tables with defaults and caveats
Identity signals such as photo or birth date stay the user's decision
cautions: Very long (43,000 characters); depth sits in six reference files
Law and platform facts are dated 2026 and need checking when it matters
Hands off to sibling skills that may not be installed
